current.text: He comes off the Detroit bench. The projected rotation has Isaiah Joe as sixth man, then Ron Holland, Paul Reed and Jenkins, behind an unchanged starting five led by Cade Cunningham.
When Cunningham was out over the final 16 games of last season, Jenkins played 31 minutes a night.
Detroit lost creation with Tobias Harris and has few creators besides Cunningham, so the team may need Jenkins as a second ball handler.
He has the best category upside on the Detroit bench. The expert calls him draftable in 16-team leagues and a late-round swing in case he gets a 26-minute role.
A bigger role depends on Bickerstaff changing the rotation or on a Cunningham injury. The experts do not expect him to start.
